name: Synchronis Medical, LLC
old_description: WE KNOW SUPPLY CHAIN, DEVICE MANUFACTURING AND THE ISSUES THAT AFFECT TODAY’S HEALTHCARE PROVIDERS.
about:
Synchronis Medical operates from Romulus, Michigan. The company was conceived as a platform to turn medical device concepts into marketable products, though a founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been released.

The firm provides design, development, contract packaging, and manufacturing services with a focus on medical kitting. Production takes place in a Class 8 clean room equipped with a form-fill-seal machine that includes in-line printing, and a second room handles lower-run specialty kits and high-volume convenience kits using impulse sealing. Additional capabilities include contract manufacturing, private labeling, product development, sourcing, PPE procurement, and sterilization services such as validation, bioburden monitoring, shelf-life testing, and ETO processing. Senior leadership brings over 100 years of combined medical device experience, and the company holds patents for the Halo Seal and Halo Vent Chest Seals used by militaries worldwide.

Customers include major hospital systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs), medical manufacturers, and military organizations globally. The company serves the medical device, healthcare provider, and defense sectors, offering customized kits and private-label products for clinical and tactical use.

Synchronis Medical differentiates itself through its ISO 13485-accredited quality system, extra ETO chamber capacity, and a mission to disrupt medical device procurement by delivering validated, low-cost solutions directly from manufacturers. The firm emphasizes ethical practices, clinical experience, and the ability to customize solutions for changing healthcare needs.
